scope: Verify implemented capabilities, add missing tests, and fix exposed defects. Absent RFC features require separately agreed implementation scope.

owner_directives.text: Full RFC support is the long-term goal, not every session’s acceptance criterion.
requirements: First verify implemented capabilities through their real entry points, including interoperability where applicable.
Add missing tests for those capabilities and fix defects they expose.
Record unimplemented RFC requirements as explicit gaps. Recording a gap does not authorize implementing it.
Do not add an absent RFC feature without a separately agreed implementation scope.
Report implemented-and-tested, implemented-but-unverified, and unimplemented behavior separately. Do not claim full support where gaps remain.
Preserve existing unfinished work, but do not expand it merely to complete an RFC.

started_work_completion: Implementation started before the baseline-first directive is authorized for full completion only after the testing gap is closed.
source_state: Uncommitted protocol changes are preserved. Feature expansion stopped at the owner's baseline-first directive.

implemented_and_tested.boundary: 320 independently decoded records. This does not prove daemon configuration or live interface-counter collection.

implemented_and_tested.boundary: 12 decoded datagrams, 28 counter samples and two packet samples. Counter generations were supplied by the smoke program, not the Linux collector.

implemented_but_unverified: Latest PPP/L2TP ownership, authentication and session-lifetime fixes; earlier package results do not cover all subsequent edits.
RSVP reservation-control API migration and native forwarding changes remain unfinished and do not compile.
Native BGP-LS export, AIGP metric reannouncement, RTR mutual TLS and MOBIKE migration contain newly introduced work. Its completion remains held until the testing gap is closed.
Remaining OSPF, IS-IS, FlowSpec, EVPN/MUP/SRv6 and gateway changes lack a completed, current end-to-end baseline.

Support remaining records absent Hello, ATM/Frame Relay, IPv6 signaling and other features. Existing planning records do not authorize implementation.

gap_record_limit: These are existing declared gaps, not a fresh source audit. Reconcile them against preserved unfinished code before publishing coverage counts. Missing test coverage alone does not prove missing implementation.
observed_failures_before_minimal_build_r: Documentation verification cannot build the live catalog: undefined ppp.CloseFD in reactor_kernel.go.
RSVP engine.go calls undefined refreshPeriod; show_data.go still assigns float64 bandwidth to float32 fields.
OSPF BGP-LS export calls missing IsRouterInformation and DecodeLANAdjSIDValueV6 APIs.
The IGP package run also found IS-IS/OSPF test compilation errors and failed TestNSSASourcePreferencePreservesOtherExits.
Documentation verification found stale firewall digest links to the removed localaddr.go.

build_only_evidence.result: The Linux 7.2 runtime kernel built successfully. Packet forwarding, fragmentation and XFRM migration have not been proved by that build.

next_verification_boundary: Close the testing gap for implemented capabilities. Allow only defects and minimal build or fixture repairs needed for that proof. Complete pre-cutoff implementation afterward; do not start absent features.
